motionPolicy.coldImages: Consume/static if any scene image is not loaded and already decoded. img.decode() only primes a bounded source cache for later scenes, never starts the current consumed entrance, and never delays controls.
motionPolicy.replay: Within one mounted controller, replaced nodes resume elapsed progress. Reload/recreated controller settles previously observed scenes statically. Recent history retains up to 8 journeys and 128 scenes per journey; older retired journeys may enter anew.
motionPolicy.reducedMotion: Immediately cancel to final static output and consume current scene; changing the setting back does not replay it.
